name: Adolf Hitler
role: Leader of the Nazi Party; dictator of Germany (1933-1945)
summary: Leader of the Nazi Party whose ideology combined extreme nationalism, a racial definition of the nation and antisemitism with rejection of democracy, Marxism and class conflict. He ruled Germany as a one-party dictatorship, pursued territorial conquest in the East and presided over the Holocaust.
